snippet.title: Underground Nomads - Playtest Trailer
snippet.description:
Join the playtest now on Steam! 

You're the commander of a drilling train, leading a clan of dwarves through the underground depths toward the planetary core. Manage the crew, complete expeditions, gather resources, upgrade equipment, and make tough choices to reach the abandoned city and return your people to their home!
